claims.claim_text: EVgo Services was initially formed as a limited liability company by NRG Energy, Inc. on October 6, 2010.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.source_quote: EVgo Services, LLC (EVgo Services, Predecessor), formerly known as NRG EV Services, LLC, was initially formed as a limited liability company by its then-sole member, NRG Energy, Inc. (NRG) on October 6, 2010.

claims.claim_text: Nissan North America, Inc. was admitted as a member of EVgo Services on July 3, 2014.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.source_quote: On July 3, 2014, the EVgo Services Limited Liability Company Agreement was amended and restated to admit Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) as a member of the EVgo Services.

claims.claim_text: EV Holdings acquired 39.99% of EVgo Services total issued and outstanding membership interests on June 17, 2016.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.source_quote: On June 17, 2016 (the Closing Date), concurrent with the closing of the Acquisition and the Initial Required Capital Contribution, EVgo Services Limited Liability Company Agreement was amended and restated to assign to EV Holdings 82,820,634 Class A Preferred Units, representing all of the issued and outstanding Class A Preferred Units.

claims.claim_text: EVgo Services was acquired by EVgo Holdco (controlled by LS Power Equity Partners IV, L.P.) on January 16, 2020.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.object_value: LS Power Equity Partners IV, L.P. / January 16, 2020
claims.source_quote: On January 16, 2020 (the Merger Date), EVgo Services and its investors consummated the transactions contemplated pursuant to that certain Agreement and Plan of Merger (Merger) with EVgo Holdco, LLC (EVgo Holdco, the Company or Successor), whereby EVgo Services became a wholly-owned subsidiary of EVgo Holdco, resulting in a change in control by the Predecessor. EVgo Holdco, controlled by LS Power Equity Partners IV, L.P. (LS Power), had no operations prior to the Merger.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2020, the company had a cash balance of $7.9 million and a working capital deficit of $43.6 million.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.object_value: $7.9 million cash / $43.6 million working capital deficit
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2020, the Company had a cash balance of $7.9 million and a working capital deficit of $43.6 million including amounts due under the related party note payable.

claims.claim_text: The company had total projected cash outflow for the twelve months ending December 31, 2021 of $115.0 million.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.source_quote: The Company s total projected cash outflow for the twelve months ending December 31, 2021 is $115.0 million.

claims.claim_text: The company builds and operates a national ecosystem of public charging stations and fleet charging solutions for electric vehicles.
claims.subject: EVgo Inc.
claims.object_value: public EV charging stations / fleet charging solutions / nationwide
claims.source_quote: The Company builds publicly available and customer-dedicated electric vehicle (EV) charging stations capable of charging electric vehicles either via direct current power or alternating current power. It has built, and continues to expand, a national ecosystem of public charging stations and fleet charging solutions.
